description: Remove the background from photos of people and download a transparent PNG. The image is processed on your device.
ogTitle: Background Remover - Transparent PNG, No Upload
ogDescription: Cut out a person from a photo and save a transparent PNG without uploading the image.
ldDescription: Remove the background from a photo of a person in the browser and download a transparent PNG.
lede: Load a photo, let the on-device model find the person and download the cut-out as a transparent PNG. Nothing is uploaded.

faq.a: Photos of people - portraits, talking-head frames and product shots with a person. The model is trained on people, so objects and animals are not its target.

faq.q: Why does the first run take longer?
faq.a: The page downloads a segmentation model (about 10 MB) once. Later visits use the browser cache and the cut-out is quick.
Not by hand. The mask is a smooth estimate, so hair and fine edges can be soft. Lower the edge strength slider if you want a cleaner, harder edge.
